# Bisu Ghalan

> Bisu Ghalan is a computer science student and security researcher from Bhaktapur, Nepal who builds Telegram bots, command-line tools, and full-stack web apps.

Site: https://bisu.com.np

## Projects

- **BinaryInspector**: Rust CLI for inspecting ELF binaries, headers, and security mitigations without executing them. [Project page](https://bisu.com.np/projects/binary-inspector); [source](https://github.com/bisug/BinaryInspector)
- **Paila**: Travel platform connecting tourists with local hosts in Nepal. Built with Next.js and Supabase. [Project page](https://bisu.com.np/projects/paila); [source](https://github.com/bisug/Paila); [live site](https://paila-prototype.vercel.app)
- **tgcrypto-c**: Maintained fork of pyrogram/tgcrypto with AES-NI hardware acceleration (6-14x faster), reusable streaming contexts, and wheels for Linux/macOS/Windows. Drop-in replacement for tgcrypto. [Project page](https://bisu.com.np/projects/tgcrypto-c); [source](https://github.com/bisug/tgcrypto-c); [live site](https://pypi.org/project/tgcrypto-c/)
- **ninfo**: Linux system info CLI in Nim that captures a whole-system snapshot as JSON in one call. No root, no dependencies, single static binary. [Project page](https://bisu.com.np/projects/ninfo); [source](https://github.com/bisug/ninfo)
- **heroku-buildpack-bun**: Heroku buildpack for Bun: installs official binaries, caches builds, and runs bun install. [Project page](https://bisu.com.np/projects/heroku-buildpack-bun); [source](https://github.com/bisug/heroku-buildpack-bun)
- **SnakeGame-CLI**: Classic Snake game in the terminal. Cross-platform, no GUI dependencies. [Project page](https://bisu.com.np/projects/snake-game-cli); [source](https://github.com/bisug/SnakeGame-CLI)
